label: D1 reward-received while committed to a2, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (100% of mass), and almost exclusively when the agent is about to choose a2 (its own upcoming choice, which it computes; policy logit a1-a2 in [-4.4,-1.5] for 99% of mass). It never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1s, or before an a1 choice. It is strongly gated by episode time: zero activity in trials 0-9, rate climbs steadily to 5.5% in trials 90-99, and it tracks low value-head output (no activity when value > 7.7). The observed-only variant prev_action==2 instead of action==2 gives recall 0.82 vs 1.0 at similar precision; the upcoming-choice version was recorded because the agent computes it. Magnitude: strongest on the first reward after a run of unrewarded trials (top examples are r1 after r0 r0 r0) and it decays over consecutive rewarded trials (0.56 -> 0.09 -> 0.04). Precision is only ~0.25 because many late rewarded a2 D1s stay inactive, particularly mid-reward-streak, so the description is incomplete.
